universalFillerRules.pattern: 您(?:老人家)?先歇着|慢走不送
universalFillerRules.remedy: Cut farewell/greeting pleasantries (Early-Out rule); end dialogue immediately on stakes or action.

universalFillerRules.pattern: 免得[^，。！？]{3,24}(?:看出端倪|惹来盘问|生出疑心|引人注意|露出马脚)
universalFillerRules.remedy: Cut 'so as not to...' explanatory tail; let the physical action carry the subtext.
Replace narrator exclamation with direct physical observation.

universalFillerRules.pattern: 不得不说的是|时间一晃眼|转眼间便来到了|话说另一头|且说另一边
universalFillerRules.remedy: Hard-cut to the next scene's sensory or time anchor without glue phrases.
Delete summary transitions ('After finishing this precaution...'); cut directly to the next concrete action.

universalFillerRules.pattern: 心头(?:微紧|一紧|一沉|暗凛)
universalFillerRules.remedy: Delete redundant prop reactions and internal emotion labels already shown by action.

classical-xianxia.title: 古典仙侠 / 硬派修真 / 东方玄幻
classical-xianxia.registerFormula: 85% 洗练规范现代白话动作骨架 + 15% 考究道门法度、器物与古历法名物

voiceMatrix.highTier: 惜字如金，断语定生死，不放狠话不解释，视低阶如损耗品
voiceMatrix.midTier: 体制化冷漠，拿门规条文、灵石折算、差役损耗施压，绝不用县衙捕快叫骂腔
voiceMatrix.lowTier: 恭谨简短、话留三分、重行当规矩与成本核算，不用胡同儿化贫嘴腔

registerRules.pattern: (?:(?:子|丑|寅|卯|辰|巳|午|未|申|酉|戌|亥)时(?:九|十[一二]?)刻|(?:九|十[一二三四五六七八九]?|[二三四五六七八九]十[一二三四五六七八九]?)刻钟)
registerRules.remedy: A shichen holds at most eight ke (chu 1-4 + zheng 1-4); nine or more ke is impossible. Fix the count or use 时辰 / 柱香 / chu-zheng notation.

clicheRules.pattern: 拉胯|赋能|逻辑闭环|降维打击|心态崩了|秒懂|颗粒度|底层逻辑
默运《[^》]+》将体内|强横(?:法力|灵压)
(?:一共|共)分[为成]?[一二三四五六七八九十]+(?:层|重|境|级|品)|(?:划分为)[一二三四五六七八九十]+(?:层|重|境|级|品)

historical-court.title: 历史权谋 / 严肃古风 / 古言正剧
historical-court.registerFormula: 85% 沉稳规范现代书面语 + 15% 准确官制、礼法、器物与时令称谓

voiceMatrix.highTier: 重政治潜台词与礼法分寸，喜怒不形于色
voiceMatrix.midTier: 公文程式与官场体面并重，威胁藏于考成与律例
voiceMatrix.lowTier: 守尊卑礼数与行当本分，忌现代网络梗与修仙词汇串入

registerRules.pattern: (?:(?:子|丑|寅|卯|辰|巳|午|未|申|酉|戌|亥)时(?:[四五六七八九十]|十[一二])刻|(?:九|十[一二三四五六七八九]?|[二三四五六七八九]十[一二三四五六七八九]?)刻钟)
registerRules.remedy: Use authentic 初/正 timekeeping, night watch (更鼓), or 时辰/柱香 durations (at most 8 ke per shichen).

registerRules.pattern: 神识|灵石|筑基|元婴|储物袋|法力|灵气
registerRules.remedy: Remove cultivation terms leaked into historical fiction.

registerRules.pattern: 性价比|情绪价值|信息差|内卷|KPI|时间节点|闭环
registerRules.remedy: Replace modern corporate jargon with period-authentic equivalents.

registerRules.pattern: 蕾丝(?:花边)?|雪纺|百褶超短裙
registerRules.remedy: Replace modern textile anachronisms with period-authentic fabrics.
An empress is addressed as 皇后 or 娘娘 in Chinese historical settings, not 殿下 or 陛下.

clicheRules.pattern: 拉胯|赋能|逻辑闭环|降维打击|心态崩了|秒懂|颗粒度|底层逻辑

mystery-thriller.title: 悬疑刑侦 / 民俗诡秘 / 无限流智斗
mystery-thriller.registerFormula: 高密度感官限知白描 + 冷硬短句 + 零剧透悬念控制

voiceMatrix.highTier: 压迫感来自信息垄断与反常平静
voiceMatrix.midTier: 职业化冷峻，只谈证据、规则与时间窗
voiceMatrix.lowTier: 受惊或隐瞒时的生理微反应，少空洞尖叫

registerRules.pattern: 恐怖如斯|诡异莫测|不可名状的恐惧|令人毛骨悚然的气息|死亡的阴影笼罩
registerRules.remedy: Replace abstract horror labels with concrete sensory textures (sound, temperature, odor, residue).

registerRules.pattern: 殊不知|他做梦也没想到|只是此刻他还不知道|谁也没有注意到角落里|命运早已(?:悄然)?写好
registerRules.remedy: Keep strict limited POV; never spoil future turns via omniscient commentary.

urban-realism.title: 现代都市 / 职场商战 / 现实言情
urban-realism.registerFormula: 当代干净规范书面叙事 + 贴合职业年龄的自然生活对白

voiceMatrix.highTier: 克制简练，谈利益边界与结果，不端古装架子
voiceMatrix.midTier: 职场分寸与潜台词拉扯
voiceMatrix.lowTier: 鲜活当代口语，忌半文言古装酸词串味

voiceMatrix.lowTier: 允许现代网感与内心吐槽，但严禁枯燥设定说明书
